intro: Wildflower, the Arizona bakery-cafe (also known as Wildflower Bread Company), is a fast-casual spot built on fresh-baked artisan bread, serving a full breakfast of frittatas, pancakes and egg plates, plus signature sandwiches, big salads, soups and toasts through the day. Below is the full Wildflower menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Wildflower, breakfast runs about $6.59 to $10.99 (frittatas and the Baja Breakfast Bowl are $10.99, pancakes $7.79), signature sandwiches are $9.79 to $13.29, and big salads $8.99 to $10.59. A half sandwich with soup or salad is $11.79. The fresh-baked bread, frittatas and sandwiches are the draw. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Wildflower value: oatmeal ($6.79) and berries & yogurt ($6.59) are the cheapest breakfasts, and the half sandwich with soup or salad ($11.79) is the best lunch value. Soup-and-sandwich or soup-and-salad combos are $12.59. A side Caesar or field greens salad is just $3.49. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is breakfast at Wildflower?
faqs.a: Breakfast runs about $6.59 to $10.99: berries and yogurt are $6.59, pancakes $7.79, an egg breakfast $8.99, and frittatas or the Baja breakfast bowl $10.99. Breakfast is a big part of Wildflower's menu. Prices vary by location.

Wildflower, the Arizona bakery-cafe (Wildflower Bread Company), is known for its fresh-baked artisan bread and a from-scratch cafe menu of frittatas and pancakes at breakfast, signature sandwiches, big salads and soups. It is a well-loved local fast-casual spot.

faqs.q: Does Wildflower do soup and sandwich combos?
faqs.a: Yes. A half sandwich with a cup of soup or a salad is about $11.79, and full sandwich-and-soup or salad-and-soup combos are $12.59. These combos are the most popular lunch value. Prices vary by location.
Wildflower does not publish full per-item calorie counts, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Totals vary with the sandwich, the bread and the sides you choose.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Wildflower?
faqs.a: Favorites include the frittatas, the Wildflower grilled cheese, the Southwest superfood salad, avocado toast with eggs, and the Reuben.
